question: If sec θ + tan θ = (3)/(2), then the value of cos θ is
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

If sec θ + tan θ = p, then cos θ = 2p ÷ (p² + 1).

Given p = 3/2, substitute directly into the shortcut formula.

cos θ = (2 × 3/2) ÷ ((3/2)² + 1)

cos θ = 3 ÷ (9/4 + 1) = 3 ÷ (13/4) = 12/13

**∴ The correct answer is 12/13.**
